onboarding.title: Robot Warzone as your screen title. It matches the name on the game's menu screen.
onboarding.description: Fight off waves of robots in this offline top-down war shooter. Everyone on the battlefield carries an AK-47. Dodge their bursts, take cover behind sandbags and crates, scrap scouts, grunts and heavy robots, grab health kits, and see how many waves you can survive. Works without internet. Touch controls: move with your left thumb, aim and fire with your right.
